description: This file defines data structures, enums, and a singleton class for managing health status monitoring within the OpenClaw application. It includes models for health snapshots, logic for polling health data, interpreting channel health, and exposing health status information for UI and logic purposes.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for periodically fetching, updating, and providing access to the health status of the application itself, including managing refresh cycles, error handling, and exposing status properties for UI display.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Used in tests to manually set the health snapshot and last error for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic health check polling process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic health check polling process.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand or scheduled fetch of health data from the control channel, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: isChannelHealthy
methods.description: Determines if a given channel summary indicates a healthy state.

methods.name: describeProbeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of failures in health probes.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Identifies the primary linked channel from the current health snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds an alternative healthy channel if the linked one is unhealthy.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current overall health state of the application.

methods.name: summaryLine
methods.description: Provides a short textual summary of the current health status.

methods.name: detailLine
methods.description: Provides detailed human-readable information about the last error or status.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Generates a detailed failure description based on snapshot, fallback message, and link status.

methods.name: degradedSummary
methods.description: Returns a short summary explaining why the health status is degraded, if applicable.
